column1: # Amedia local-newspaper domains for the auto-apply feature (options page ->
# "Automatic sites"). This file is the source of truth; manifest.json's
# host_permissions is generated from it — after editing this file,
# A domain belongs here only if BOTH are true:
#   1. Wikipedia's "Aviser eid av Amedia" category lists it as Amedia-owned
#      was confirmed directly, like avisa-hordaland.no and iharstad.no.
#   2. Its homepage HTML actually loads assets from acdn.no — the CDN behind
#      without the platform fingerprint (or vice versa) doesn't count.
# Verified 2026-08-28 by fetching each homepage live and grepping for
# --- Checked and deliberately left out — don't re-add without re-verifying ---
# avvir.no        Ávvir            Amedia-owned but no acdn.no fingerprint; different platform (Sámi-language paper).
# demokraten.no   Demokraten       301-redirects to dagsavisen.no/demokraten — a Dagsavisen section, not an Amedia site.
# (unknown)       Stjørdalens Blad Wikipedia infobox gave bladet.no; loads but no fingerprint. Real domain not confirmed.
# ialta.no        iAlta            Connection failed outright; likely dead or merged into another local title.
